description: This file implements a compaction safeguard extension for a chat or agent system, handling session summarization, pruning, quality checks, and context management to optimize conversation history and prevent overflows.

methods.name: clampNonNegativeInt
methods.description: Normalizes a value to a non-negative integer, falling back to a default if invalid.

methods.name: resolveRecentTurnsPreserve
methods.description: Resolves and clamps the number of recent turns to preserve during summarization.

methods.name: resolveQualityGuardMaxRetries
methods.description: Resolves and clamps the maximum retries for quality guard checks.

methods.name: normalizeFailureText
methods.description: Trims and normalizes failure message text.

methods.name: truncateFailureText
methods.description: Truncates failure message text to a maximum number of characters.

methods.name: formatToolFailureMeta
methods.description: Formats metadata for tool failure details.

methods.name: extractToolResultText
methods.description: Extracts text content from tool result content.

methods.name: collectToolFailures
methods.description: Collects and deduplicates tool failure messages from agent messages.

methods.name: formatToolFailuresSection
methods.description: Formats a section listing tool failures.

methods.name: computeFileLists
methods.description: Computes sorted lists of read and modified files from file operations.

methods.name: formatFileOperations
methods.description: Formats file operation lists into a bounded string section.

methods.name: capCompactionSummary
methods.description: Caps a summary string to a maximum character length, adding a truncated marker if needed.

methods.name: capCompactionSummaryPreservingSuffix
methods.description: Caps a summary string while preserving a suffix section within character limits.

methods.name: extractMessageText
methods.description: Extracts plain text from an agent message, concatenating blocks if necessary.

methods.name: formatNonTextPlaceholder
methods.description: Generates a placeholder string for non-text content blocks.

methods.name: splitPreservedRecentTurns
methods.description: Splits messages into summarizable and preserved recent turns based on configuration.

methods.name: formatPreservedTurnsSection
methods.description: Formats a section listing preserved recent turns.

methods.name: extractLatestUserAsk
methods.description: Retrieves the latest user message text from a list of messages.

methods.name: readWorkspaceContextForSummary
methods.description: Reads and formats workspace context rules from AGENTS.md for inclusion in summaries.
